_readme: Scroll-driven masterplan flyover. Edit this file to retune the experience —
no component code needs to change.
x / y are normalized plan-image coordinates: 0-1, origin at the image's
top-left. The seed values below were eyeballed from plan_bg.png. To retune
them, open the flyover with ?wp appended to the URL and click any point —
the normalized coordinate is copied to your clipboard and logged.
zoom 1 = the plan exactly covers the viewport. Zoom is clamped at runtime
to maxUpscale so the camera can never push past what the source resolves;
on this 1418x1002 CAD plan that ceiling is reached at roughly zoom 2.4.
Supplying a 4000px+ rendered masterplan is what would lift it.
duration = length of the travel leg INTO this waypoint (unitless).
hold = extra scroll held with the camera still, for reading and video.

_moreStops: Four more amenities already have video on disk and are one entry away:
gym, cricket, pickleball, lounge. Copy a waypoint block, set amenityId to
the id from amenities.json, set showVideo true, and place x/y with ?wp.
garden and children-park currently have no video asset, so they run as
scenic beats with copy only. Add a videoPath + scrubVideoPath entry to
amenities.json and set amenityId here to give them one.
